Specification: This module defines a small collection of top-level operators intended to exercise TLA+ syntax for operator-valued constants, tuples, labeled tuple elements, set comprehension with labels, and a LET-bound local operator inside a set comprehension. It does not model a transition system: there are no variables, no actions, no temporal specification, and no safety or liveness properties. The file is purely structural and focuses on value-level definitions that reference a single operator-valued constant A5 and construct tuples and sets.
